notes.title: DEMO UPDATED!
notes.content:
Based on all the feedback received in the last two months, several big changes have been implemented. There is still a lot of work to be done and the demo will get updated again soon with more fixes and adjustments.

This update content includes/changes the following aspects of the game:
[list]
[*] Cards now have a cost (number of free rounds needed in the cylinder, similar to a mana system)
[*] Enemies now will act in a much more coherent way, and you can see their intention for the next round.
[*] The map has now a fixed size that will hopefully let your deck grow enough before facing the boss
[*] Reworked the dueling events (still some work to be done)
[*] Added a boss intro screen.
[*] Added new cards (more on the way)
[*] Added 3 new enemies
[*] Overall balance of multiple cards
[*] Fixed some visual errors for ultrawide displays
[*] UI should feel smoother
[*] Added the option to shoot before having your magazine full (you can even shoot without loading any card).
[/list] 

That is all for now. Thanks to everyone that has played the demo, wishlisted the game and especially to everyone that has given me feedback on how the game could improve!
